title: SS27 Girls' Trending Trims Report
summary: Girls' trims: hand embroidery, ruffles, smocking, lined sequins, shell and bead details for older girls.
research_period: Pitti Bimbo 103, Florence, 24-25 June 2026; Playtime Paris, 28-30 June 2026; analysis July to November 2026
markets: Premium and mid-market childrenswear, Europe-led fairs, global retail

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Fatamadrina lists oversized florals, checks with fruit prints, paisley, vintage geometrics, nautical themes and gingham, and "Wildflowers Bloom" with delicate handcrafted embroidery<sup>[1]</sup>
- Selini Action makes handmade costumes decorated with shells, pebbles, seaweed and embroidery<sup>[2]</sup>
- Pitti Bimbo 103 took "The Pitti Pool" as its theme and called it "the most colorful summer edition yet"<sup>[3]</sup>

sections.heading: Trims table
sections.body:
| Trim | Application | Safety note |
|---|---|---|
| Embroidery | Dresses | Soft backing |
| Smocking | Dresses | None |
| Sequins | Party | Lined |
| Shells and beads | Older girls only | Pull-test |

design_implications:
- No small parts for younger sizes.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, snaps and decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
